summary: Phase 4 BLOCKED: GeneralExistPart as implemented uses Formula.top/bot with full r-var NF precondition, making it circular at the sorry site. The precondition (nf_eval_nf M (k'+1+1) 2 [x,t] sub_nf) IS what the proof needs to establish. Individual 1-var NF agreements (h_x_agree, h_t_agree) are provably insufficient to derive 2-var NF agreement (Z counterexample). The fix requires re-implementing GeneralExistPart with individual 1-var NF parameters and actual temporal formula construction (zone decomposition), as originally designed in report 05 Section 2.2.

blockers.goal_state:
∀ (sub_nf_1 : NormalForm sig (k' + 1) (1 + 1 + 1)),
    (∃ x_1, nf_eval_nf M (k' + 1) (1 + 1 + 1) (Fin.cons x_1 (Fin.cons x fun x ↦ t)) sub_nf_1) ↔ sub_nf.2 sub_nf_1 = true
blockers.what_failed: ih_general_exist requires nf_eval_nf M (k'+1+1) 2 (Fin.cons x (fun _ => t)) sub_nf as precondition, but proving this IS the goal (atoms + quantifiers, and the quantifier part is exactly what we need ih_general_exist for)
blockers.root_cause: GeneralExistPart implementation uses Formula.top/bot shortcut with full r-var NF precondition instead of constructing actual temporal formulas with individual 1-var NF parameters
blockers.fix_required: Re-implement GeneralExistPart with: (1) parameter env_nfs : Fin r -> NF(k+1,1) instead of env_nf : NF(k+1,r), (2) precondition ∀ i, nf_eval_nf M (k+1) 1 (fun _ => e i) (env_nfs i) instead of nf_eval_nf M (k+1) r e env_nf, (3) actual temporal formula construction via zone decomposition instead of classical Formula.top/bot split
